mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plugin_account (installation_id, account_id, display_name, account_json, enabled) VALUES (#{installationId}, #{accountId}, #{displayName}, CAST(#{accountJson} AS JSON), #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = VALUES(display_name), account_json = VALUES(account_json), enabled = VALUES(enabled), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM plugin_account WHERE installation_id = #{installationId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE plugin_account SET group_id = #{groupId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE installation_id = #{installationId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
